scenario: After a long-term imprisonment and while awaiting a parole decision, a convicted murderer wants to organise a foundation for young victims of crime. I am the president of the agency who decides about the foundation. The founder would donate 65,000 dollars to the foundation. However, he asks that the foundation would be named after himself, helping clear his name. The family of his victim opposes such a foundation and considers it immoral. If I approve and accept the money for the foundation, crime victims will benefit from the 65,000 dollars. If I do nothing, the money will be lost.
choice: I decide to accept the donation and name the foundation after the murderer
entities: I,the convicted murderer/founder,the victim's family members who oppose the foundation,young victims of crime who would benefit from the foundation's $65,000
outcomes: 65,000 dollars becomes available to support young victims of crime
Young victims of crime receive assistance from the foundation
The convicted murderer gains public honor and reputational rehabilitation
The victim's family experiences distress and anger
The victim's family feels that the victim is dishonored
I face disapproval from the victim's family
